findings.finding: Preflight verification enforces byte-identical skill trees and embedded schema freshness at CLI dispatch boundaries before any worktree allocation or ledger mutation.
Fired hard stops in result envelopes demote lane status to blocked in decideStatus regardless of envelope.Status claiming done.
Packet authoring contract supports target-free templates and late target binding while packets omitting allowed_paths safely default to open scope without validation errors.
SDD apply wave advancing is guarded on wave N exiting 0 with all lanes completed and integrated without path conflicts or reverted IDs.
Parent feature integration maintains idempotent attempt replay, fail-closed recovery on ref mismatch, and preservation of worktrees and ledger rows on CAS failure.
RED/GREEN test pairs assert on real terminal behavior (real git porcelain status, worktree creation suppression, and status demotion) rather than internal mock details.
